description: This JavaScript source file defines a custom culture info configuration for the 'smj-NO' (Sami in Norway) language, including localized day names, month names, date formats, regex patterns for parsing, and extensions to the Date prototype for culture-specific date handling.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets the time components of a Date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this Date to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two Date objects are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone name for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset for a given timezone name.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets multiple components of a Date object based on configuration.

methods.name: moveToFirstDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the Date to the first day of its month.

methods.name: moveToLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the Date to the last day of its month.

methods.name: moveToNthOccurrence
methods.description: Moves to the nth occurrence of a specific day of week in the month.

methods.name: moveToDayOfWeek
methods.description: Moves to a specific day of week within the current week/period.

methods.name: moveToMonth
methods.description: Moves to a specific month.

methods.name: getWeek
methods.description: Calculates the week number for the date.

methods.name: getISOWeek
methods.description: Calculates the ISO week number for the date.

methods.name: setWeek
methods.description: Sets the week number for the date.
